text: Reddit上有人发了条：“我的智能门锁更新固件后，半夜自己开了三次，客服说这是‘安全补丁’。”看完我只有一个想法：科技公司定义“安全”的方式，跟我们普通人的恐惧真不在一个维度。

Unpopular opinion: Docker is a crutch for lazy devs. Everyone says containers fix "works on my machine," but they just mask bad dependency hygiene. A well-pinned requirements.txt and a Makefile beat a 2GB image every time.
